resources.string: Choose what each controller button does in the desktop
Tap a button in the list, then press that button on the controller within 10 seconds. What the app receives is saved next to it, and then you choose what it does in the desktop.
%s: arrives as a tap, like the trigger, so it stays a click
%s: nothing arrives, the system keeps it
Record controller input in the desktop
Input log (newest first, also in logcat with the QuestX11Input tag)
Key names joined with +, for example ctrl+c, alt+tab, super, esc, f5, up, pagedown.
